campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine:
Owner-directed replanning on 2026-09-04: validate the existing integrated capabilities before simplification, preserving the capability freeze enforced by structure. docs/plan.json is the sole live execution plan. Retain open row identities and gated historical completion references. No new model family, workflow, optimizer or general orchestration framework is admitted. Limit construction to reproduced defects, missing acceptance in existing owners, regression protection and evidence-backed simplification. The operator explicitly resumed implementation on 2026-09-04: gate this revision first, then execute ready steps through the existing dispatcher. This instruction supersedes the earlier user-stop; future operator stops still take precedence.

Document order ranks ready work; depends_on is the authority for prerequisites. Publish current-surface long-form admission records and run remaining benchmark and modality evidence now, without waiting for unrelated fixes or simplification. Preserve current-surface evidence as the before picture. Incorrect or unavailable capabilities remain explicit gaps, not passing evidence. A demonstrated defect blocks only affected claims. On an explicit resume, independent work may overlap through existing conflict-checked worktree/resource leases; shared files and exclusive GPU timing require resource coordination, not artificial capability dependencies. One writer owns a plan edit and gates it before any dispatch.

The existing long-form record already binds corpus-at-commit, floors, model and inference surface. Extend only the missing cross-revision guarantees: identical corpus/token inputs and explicit accepted baseline IDs, plus bounded cancellation in the existing longform command. These additions gate regression-baseline acceptance, not existing benchmark admission or modality runs. Raw instruction-model NLL alone is not an accuracy defect; preserve the observed chat ranking, add the chat-shaped rung and use matched-checkpoint references for published comparisons. Diagnostic regressions must not become accepted baselines.

Retain existing parity tests, longform tests and report checks as useful lower bounds. Before implementing or measuring a dispatched row, use plan -setverify to add its missing quantitative, coverage or runtime assertion to those checks; never replace useful checks with blanket exit-1 placeholders. New fixtures name an exact test and require its file; absent, skipped or zero-matching tests cannot pass. A build or successful listing alone does not establish capability, and report freshness is only a freshness check. Every acceptance names its model/task/case denominator, protocols, evidence identities, thresholds and exclusions. Extend the existing command/test owner only where an assertion is missing. UNAVAILABLE stays visible with a finding/disposition and is never successful capability evidence.

Use scoped host/kernel tests while fixing, a small recipe-derived execution-coverage set for each execution change, then full final verification of invalidated capabilities. Coverage includes operator path, weight type, head geometry, cache policy and modality; one model per weight type is insufficient. Publish a small accepted immutable guard baseline and enforce the regression gate before broad execution changes. The 2026-09-05 measurements establish a narrow prerequisite exception: complete-coverage corrects missing fixed-budget fingerprint coverage and repair-throughput corrects the reproduced Qwen rate-floor failure before healthy baseline acceptance. These repairs retain exact failed before records, CPU/device parity, isolated resident-cache timing and unchanged thresholds; failed measurements never become healthy references. Commit each producer or repair before clean-tree model publication. Unrelated defect optimization, modality expansion and simplification retain their accepted-guard prerequisites. Expand and re-accept the full catalog after fixes and modality evidence; preserve original records and refuse to normalize known failures. All simplification follows the initial modality report and small-model benchmark pass. Compare quality, throughput and peak/retained memory on identical inputs with declared reference bounds and repeated isolated timing; no aggregate gain hides a required regression. Reuse exact unaffected evidence with recorded independence, rerunning only invalidated slices.

Every evaluate pass carries an explicit measured -budget. Run small models first; the full 27B MMLU-Pro pass is operator-launched with -budget 3h and must not be started by another row. Keep all 12032 cases and both protocols; incomplete bounded runs remain incomplete. MATH is excluded. Publish evidence only from a clean worktree after implementation lands. Gates read exact accepted evidence for long campaigns rather than launching hours of publication. Store paths resolve the intended canonical store under OVERGO_DATA_ROOT. Extend longform's missing aggregate budget before its full regression-baseline campaign; existing per-rung admission remains usable now.

Reproduce findings through cmd/finding with affected claims. Correctness, security, data-loss or invalid-measurement defects interrupt affected work and receive explicit prerequisites; independent validation continues. Preserve historical evidence and checkpoint content identities. Relocation must verify the destination and rollback before retiring the original. Simplification must remove measured maintenance cost while preserving capability. Closeout joins every terminal branch, includes post-change modality revalidation where affected, and cannot clear an explicit user stop.

Optimize capability per wall-hour by simplifying existing implementation: remove redundant transfers, copies, cache ownership, branching and duplicate numerical paths before adding mechanisms. Rank admitted changes by measured throughput/memory/reliability gain or recurring maintenance cost removed. Each slice identifies before evidence, behavior retained, mechanism deleted and executable counterexample. Prefer existing generic owners and one derived policy; no extra controllers, compatibility wrappers or parallel report formats. File splitting and command-count reductions alone are not capability gains. Keep unrelated validation off each slice and reuse exact unaffected evidence.

Fix as you go: a failed check creates an immediate repair obligation in its existing owner. Reproduce the failure, correct its cause, and rerun the affected checks before closing the step. Findings and failed records track unfinished repairs; recording, acknowledging or deferring an in-scope defect is not completion. Preserve original failing evidence and declared thresholds; do not weaken assertions, reclassify failures as passes, or accept degraded measurements as a healthy baseline. Repair an invalid prerequisite order when it prevents the fix needed to satisfy it. Only prerequisites that genuinely require unavailable external input can remain blocked, with the affected step open; independent authorized work continues. Preserve the existing distinction between demonstrated runtime defects and expected instruction-model behavior.

Owner directive 2026-09-05: finish E4B across every supported inference modality before switching models, then validate each remaining model across all its supported modalities. The unit of work is a complete model validation bundle, not one repeat, modality probe or evidence-binding edit per commit. Derive each bundle from the union of artifact/projector declarations, recipe facts, compatibility claims and existing oracle fixtures; a text-only activation census must not hide image, audio or video inputs. Distinguish accepted text guards, numerical projector parity, end-to-end task quality and complete model validation. For each model: bind its entire input/output modality denominator and quantitative oracles, run CPU contracts before GPU parity, then full task outputs, chat/mixed-media/API behavior and isolated quality/rate/peak-retained-memory/recovery checks. Finish all repeats and local failure diagnosis for that bundle before an acceptance gate. Reuse exact unaffected records, publish each run durably to the store, and batch evidence bindings and generated reports into one acceptance commit per complete model or a larger settled group. Do not add standalone commits for every control readmission, repeat, listing or report refresh. Implementation repairs still require a coherent tested producer commit before clean-tree publication; collect related repairs with scoped checks before that gate and readmit only affected evidence afterward. No commit-count target justifies mixing unrelated behavioral changes or accepting dirty-source measurements. The E4B bundle may validate and repair its existing paths under the accepted Qwen/E4B controls without waiting for unrelated model acquisition; broad execution changes retain coverage obligations. Existing modality and benchmark rows aggregate these per-model records and run only missing or invalidated cells. Do not invent image/audio generation for an input-only model. Unsupported output modes require an artifact-bound exclusion; missing supported modes remain open repair obligations. Keep full benchmark denominators and the operator-owned27B boundary unchanged.

RSI batch promotion control: extend the existing gate/manifest/evidence owners, not a bypass switch or second orchestration framework. An authorized batch binds its base tree, plan objective, allowed scope, required acceptance and recovery checkpoint. Edits inside the batch run affected cheap checks; dependency changes invalidate only affected exact evidence. Freeze the candidate for isolated device/performance evidence and promote only after the complete required gate succeeds. Never advance plan completion for an intermediate checkpoint, stale candidate or incomplete batch. Scope expansion and failed checks reopen obligations; they cannot lower checks. Preserve clean committed producers for publication and avoid new standalone gates solely to update batch bookkeeping.

Owner-directed audio integration on2026-09-05 is an explicit capability-freeze exception for the already-developed audio worktree and its exact used Granite/Nemotron/FireRed artifacts, not permission for unrelated architectures. After the next E4B serving producer commit, immediately prepare and gate that finalized worktree into master, reconcile all remaining source obligations and register its used local models. Registration, activation, CPU parity, native streaming, training and CUDA remain distinct claims.

Owner directive 2026-09-05: consolidate the API as validation touches each owner. Reuse task-specific model lookup and inventory publication; migrate every caller and remove displaced exports, wrappers and duplicate branches in the same batch. Record the command, route and exported-symbol delta from existing census owners, alongside behavior retained and relevant parity. Capability-preserving consolidation inside a validation or intake repair need not wait for a separate cleanup commit; broad execution restructuring retains its existing regression and modality prerequisites. Avoid adding another executable or orchestration layer for artifact registration. Keep the independently evolving audio plan in its own worktree; master retains only exact intake and integration acceptance obligations.

GUI validation handoff after landed integration 090fbc1f0d54abe700d985d7a67395c6a93e314f: retain master as the validation-plan authority; professional_overgo_gui owns HTTP, browser and transport implementation. Its uncommitted work was not imported. Master owns model numerics, admission contracts, dataset quality and resource evidence. Share modelintake and mediacapability owners; HTTP callers must not fork a verification engine. The merged library registers projector candidates but cannot promote one by opening it. Complete executed media-suite support through the existing admission owner before GUI promotion; preserve the CLI's exact full-mode coverage meanwhile. The integration also fixes a reproduced conversation completion race and gate rename-scope omission. Required concurrency and gate-policy checks remain immediate. Gate scope must include both rename paths independently of Git presentation. The 101-command,133-route,311-document merged manifest describes available surface, not proof of quality. Consolidate overlapping behavior when touching an owner and retain the 9964 duplicate-excess ceiling (9935 measured at this integration). Do not add unrelated infrastructure ahead of E4B.

Audio validation integration: reuse the landed independent package evidence cache and step-local verification_batch contract. A failed, skipped, unfinished or empty package earns no credit; successful independent packages remain reusable across failure and restart only with exact transitive source, fixtures, mode and environment. The merge receipt is preflighted before expensive verification and rechecked under the final commit lock. Do not rebuild these mechanisms in a new controller.

Execute validation as one capability bundle per model. Diagnose with owning-package CPU tests, then required GPU correctness, then isolated quality/resource measurements; fix failures immediately and rerun only invalidated evidence. Collect related implementation changes before one integration gate. Model checkpoints below are mandatory lower bounds, not final model acceptance. The parent acceptance must join source-bound quality, all declared modalities/protocols and resource evidence. Publish canonical model measurements from clean committed source and freeze held-out selection/oracles before measurement. Preserve recoverable work without claiming incomplete rows complete; reduced checkpoint gates remain unavailable until the existing batch-promotion row establishes durable cumulative obligations and escalation. Missing required models, datasets, tools or assertions must be located, acquired or implemented, not silently skipped.

Retain 32768-token capacity and repeated grow/shrink/cancel/error/reload/non-growth checks as text-resource evidence; they do not establish projector-resource acceptance. Bind media cleanup, mixed-history ownership, full-output quality and resource behavior before final acceptance. Reuse historical fixed-budget controls and long-form records only after an exact source/surface and protocol independence check; the raw-continuation ladder alone does not satisfy the three fixed-budget controls. Republish invalidated admission at the current surface. Keep failed before measurements and thresholds unchanged.

Implement TestAcceptedE4BModalities in the existing compatibility owner as the final read-only join: reject any missing modality, protocol, task-quality assertion, source identity, completion denominator, resource check or unpromoted required binding. Store one evidence bundle for the model, then feed existing memory/benchmark/modality reports from those same records. Run the batch once at integration after related changes; scoped diagnostics during implementation are not completion. Master owns validation and numerical/admission repairs; GUI owns HTTP implementation, audio owns native streaming and training. No projector promotion until all declared media modes have evidence.

The producer prerequisite owns the CPU/GPU integration batch and the read-only final assertion. This row performs the clean-source measurement and evidence-binding phase: reuse exact proven-independent protocol/resource records, acquire missing or invalidated cells, then run the final read-only acceptance once. Do not repeat the producer batch for every record or report update. If measurement exposes a new runtime defect, stop affected measurement, retain the failed record, and bind one new coherent repair producer before resuming clean-source publication; never reopen a completed identity or waive source cleanliness. Other models and aggregate reports consume the same completed bundle.

items.title: Amortize gate cost over coherent verified batches

steps.title: Finish governed checkpoint promotion and measured verification scheduling
steps.verify: go test ./internal/gate -run '^(TestIndependentPackageEvidenceAcceptance|TestGovernedBatchDeclarationAcceptance|TestProjectedMergePreflightBeforeVerification|TestGateReusesUnchangedCheckEvidence|TestPackageSelectiveReuse)$' -count=1 && test -f internal/gate/batch_promotion_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestBatchPromotionControl$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
The audio merge already supplies step-local verification batches, exact subordinate completion/recovery evidence and independent per-package cache reuse. Master adds early projected-merge receipt preflight. Preserve these lower bounds; do not implement them again. The remaining work is checkpoint commits without premature parent completion, durable outstanding obligations bound to cumulative changes, mandatory escalation and measured scheduling through the existing plan/gate/OvergoDB owners.

Implement a concrete governed checkpoint path in cmd/gate: record implemented versus verified versus promoted states without pruning the parent. Persist outstanding checks with exact cumulative source/fixture/environment identities, survive interruption/restart, reject orphaning through replan or branch changes, and require one complete final integration gate. Persistence, authentication, concurrency, kernels, public contracts and gate-policy changes immediately trigger their required checks; the controller may adjust scheduling only inside declared limits. Until this exists, full gates remain mandatory for commits. Batch related implementation by capability/dependency, not commit counts; narrower diagnostics do not grant promotion.

Report wall time by phase, independently reused packages, executed checks, outstanding obligations, failures found and invalidation causes. Use the recent GUI merge failures (1757.2s and 1137.7s after successful verification) and final 952.9s run as recorded before evidence for early refusal and scheduling efficiency; do not claim these wall times predict another model. Prove saving and unchanged regression detection on repeated controlled failure/restart/replan cases, including one failed or unavailable package beside a reusable passing package. The exclusive GPU lease finding evidence:sha256:0f4b6d07607b3fa8ee6ee7f320646e5dbbd5b38b025a19c2046d54aed7fa4b4e remains open: consumers must enforce admitted resources before isolated measurements. Never silently weaken acceptance, invent missing fixtures or credit skipped cases. This automation work does not block E4B evidence acquisition.

Latest before evidence: audio merge cf3f5eb1 passed in 896.5 seconds after an interrupted run and a 592.4-second failure caused by a stale machine-local dataset root. All four explicit acceptances passed, but the later package run resolved the corpus through a different root. Preserve one resolved input contract across acceptance and package tests; validate required paths/identities before expensive verification. The corrected root changes environment identity and correctly invalidates earlier evidence. The successful gate executed 189 packages and credited none of its 472 skipped dependent fixtures. Classify those by affected required acceptance versus optional/platform coverage: resolve every required missing fixture; record unsupported-platform exclusions with exact reasons and never count them as passing. Add prompt failure reporting with the exact package/test while preserving every unrun obligation. Persist successful terminal package reports during process execution, not only after the whole group returns, and prove process-kill/restart reuse without credit for incomplete packages. Keep process supervision, recovery, rename scope, clone/style/permanent-authority preflight and exclusive GPU admission under their existing owners. Checkpoint policy changes require full existing checks and cannot self-authorize a weaker gate.
